t: Robust Stanley FatMax FMHT10505-0 Heavy Duty retractable knife designed to deliver consistent, reliable performance in demanding trade tasks. Ideal for professional use, such as cutting carpet, drywall, or insulation. The knife features a black design, hardened blade holder and spring-loaded body for fast tool-free blade changes. An integrated magnetic storage compartment safely holds up to 10 spare blades for rapid replacement, and the optimised linear design ensures strong, clean cuts. The ergonomic non-slip handle provides secure grip and control, and the pin-hinged body and redesigned magnetic nose provide precise blade alignment, ensuring strong, clean cuts with minimal blade wobble. Grip zones with a flared tail offer maximum control. This durable utility knife is essential for builders and tradespeople seeking reliable performance and efficiency on site. Supplied with 3 x induction-hardened blades and compatible with Stanley FatMax carbide utility blades.
b: Versatile & Heavy-Duty for Professional Cutting Tasks
Spring-Loaded Body for Quick Blade Access
